technique_name: Summarize the key components of fitness
description: Fitness typically consists of four components: cardiovascular endurance, muscular strength and endurance, flexibility, and body composition. Cardiovascular endurance improves the health of the heart, lungs, and circulatory system and can be improved with activities like running, swimming, cycling, and cardio classes.
